window.bar.title: Gearbook bar
window.library.title: Gearbook
window.settings.title: Gearbook settings
window.news.title: Gearbook: what is new
library.empty: No gearsets found. Log in with a character that has some.
library.column.name: Name
library.detail.favourite.help: A favourite is what the bar shows. Marking one puts it there, and the arrows below decide where in the row it sits.
gearset.incomplete: A piece of this set is missing. The game will offer a suitable replacement when you put it on.
gearset.favouriteHint: Ctrl and click marks it as a favourite. Right-click for more.
library.detail.nothingSelected: Select a gearset to see its details.
library.duplicateWarning: Another gearset has the same job and the same name. The game cannot tell them apart either.
library.orphan.heading: Not currently present
library.orphan.explain: These notes and favourites belong to gearsets that are not in the list right now. Nothing was deleted, so if the set comes back its note comes back with it.
filter.heading: Filter
view.saveAs: Save the current filter as a view
view.nameTaken: A view of that name already exists.
sort.heading: Sort by
bar.addHint: Mark gearsets as favourites, or add them to the bar from the library.
switch.blocked.inCombat: Not while you are in combat.
switch.blocked.notLoggedIn: Not while you are logged out.
switch.failed: The game refused the change. Nothing was equipped.
settings.language.help: Left on this, Gearbook speaks whatever language Dalamud is set to, and follows it when you change it. Pick a language here and that choice stays, whatever Dalamud does later.
settings.filterLevel.help: Only changes how much of the filter panel is on screen. Nothing is lost by choosing a smaller one; the views and tags you already made stay.
settings.bar.showItemLevel: Show the item level on the icon
settings.bar.highlightActive: Outline the set you are wearing
settings.bar.locked.help: A locked bar has no title bar and cannot be dragged, so it stays where you put it.
settings.bar.showOnStart: Show the bar when the plugin loads
settings.library.showGameNumber: Show the game's own gearset number
settings.library.showOrphans: Show notes whose gearset is missing
settings.library.warnDuplicates: Warn about gearsets sharing a job and a name
settings.roleOrder.help: Used when the list is sorted by role. Sorting by role is one entry in the sort control, so switching back to the game numbering is one click and changes nothing here.
settings.roleOrder.dragHint: Drag a row, or use the arrows.
settings.news.autoOpen: Open the notes once after an update
settings.perCharacterNote: Every setting here belongs to this character alone.
settings.about.noAutomation: Gearbook never switches anything on its own. Every change is one you asked for.
news.empty: No release notes for this version.
bis.state.noAccount: Eorzea Arsenal is installed but no account is connected, so there is nothing to compare against.
bis.state.loading: Eorzea Arsenal is still loading its data.
bis.state.noData: Eorzea Arsenal has no best-in-slot targets set up yet.
command.help.main: Open Gearbook. Subcommands: bar, settings, news, view <name>, switch <name or number>.
command.switch.ambiguous: More than one gearset matches {0}. Use the number instead.
